# Fourth

## Overview

- **Age:** fourteen (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064)</sub>
- **Role:** handmaiden (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Fourth is a small-framed individual who wears her hair in multiple distinct styles, ranging from numerous fine plaits bound with white thread and wrapped around her head to two crinkly, braided tails secured with four bright blue ribbons. Her attire includes a crisp, white dress so heavily starched that it is capable of standing on its own.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Fourth is a warm-hearted little handmaiden who shows genuine concern for her mistress. She is deeply devoted, honestly worrying over her adored mistress's condition.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Fourth was one of the children [Anne](../character/anne.md) cared for during her childhood spent moving between homes prior to being sent to the asylum.

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--fourth.md)

Fourth acts as a close acquaintance and assistant for [Anne](../character/anne.md) during her wedding preparations in Volume 2. Their connection stems from this supportive role during the major event. Though [Anne](../character/anne.md) previously shared her tragic childhood backstory with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) during a drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), her relationship with Fourth focuses on their shared participation in the wedding.

- Friend of — close acquaintance and assistant at wedding (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--fourth.md)

Fourth is a close acquaintance of [Diana](../character/diana.md), assisting alongside her during the wedding events in Volume 2. The two share a cooperative dynamic centered around helping with the occasion. Their interactions remain friendly and supportive throughout this shared duty.

- Friend of — close acquaintance and assistant at wedding (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--lavendar-lewis.md)

Fourth serves under [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) as of Volume 2. In this capacity, Fourth works directly in Miss Lavendar's employ, maintaining a subordinate professional relationship to her.

- Serves under (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
